author: fstephan-mbx
issueText: Reviewed manual canary for issue 38361: opening the same singleton page inside a modal NavigationPage from Shell must retain visible page content after interactive swipe-down dismissal and reopening. Preserve the author's reused page/navigation wrapper and manual disconnect policy, without manually invoking disconnect. Establish a fresh-instance modal control and the singleton's initially rendered content before the actual dismiss/reopen sequence. Observe displayed native accessibility elements and positive bounds, not rendered pixels, an injected blank page or a status-only success assertion. The candidate uses an isolated DI-backed route factory rather than the author's app-wide bootstrap; secondary navigation is present but not exercised. This new candidate has not yet been executed; the separate author-project build is not a driven original-app reproduction.
